gbm_population_evidence.quote: MR imaging findings suggestive of GB

candidate_evidence.quote: [PROCEDURE] MRF/MRI infiltration guidance for extended resection

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Feasibility as assessed by the performance of MRF/MRI infiltration mapping guidance in surgical resection of new glioblastomas

role_evidence.quote: Standard of care neurosurgical resection will include the use of all standard neurosurgical instruments and techniques (eg, microscope, intraoperative ultrasound, 5-ALA fluorescence guided surgery and neuronavigation system).

coder_notes: Imaging-guided surgery trial (MR fingerprinting); no drug intervention under test. 5-ALA appears only as an example ('eg') of standard surgical tools in the control intervention description; listed as diagnostic_agent for transparency, though it may arguably not need listing under R9. 'Prior treatment for glioblastoma' is an exclusion criterion (supports newly diagnosed). OTHER-type Group 1 is the standard-of-care control.
